title: A Portfolio Benefit Is Not A Shared Benefit
summary: A map separating project outcomes from shared dependencies, concentration, cumulative burden, distribution, portfolio safeguards, rebalancing, and exit.
map_question: What must be known before project-level results can support a portfolio-level benefit or resilience decision?
interpretation_boundary: Project compliance does not prove portfolio carrying capacity. Aggregate benefit does not prove equal incidence. More projects do not prove diversification when dependencies, hazards, authority, or burdens remain concentrated.

nodes.label: Versioned portfolio membership
nodes.note: No governed portfolio membership decision exists.

nodes.label: Admitted cross-case evidence
nodes.note: Each member retains its own audit, context, harm, and distribution record.

nodes.label: Shared dependencies
nodes.note: Infrastructure, suppliers, workforce, capital, authority, and schedules are mapped.

nodes.label: Concentration and common-mode risk
nodes.note: More members can still share a single point of failure.

nodes.label: Cumulative local burden
nodes.note: Project-level compliance does not establish system carrying capacity.

nodes.label: Cross-project distribution
nodes.note: Benefits, costs, access, exclusion, and risk are traced by affected group and place.

nodes.label: Safeguard, sequence, substitute, rebalance, or exit
nodes.note: Portfolio choices include pause and divestment, not only expansion.

nodes.label: Accountable portfolio decision
nodes.note: No portfolio governance decision or receipt exists.

links.note: Member outcomes cannot reveal all shared dependencies alone.
No safeguard or rebalancing options are adjudicated.

what_this_map_supports: Fourteen portfolio-governance gates and twelve risk triggers.
Visible dependency, concentration, cumulative-burden, distribution, and exit review.
Project identities and adverse evidence remain intact inside a portfolio.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish portfolio membership, shared benefit, diversification, resilience, carrying capacity, equity, or net benefit.
It does not authorize resource reallocation, expansion, pause, substitution, or exit.
It does not score or rank projects or portfolios.
next_records_needed: Admitted audited decisions and pairwise findings.
A versioned portfolio purpose, membership, owner, and authority record.
Shared-dependency, concentration, cumulative-burden, distribution, safeguard, and governance receipts.
